params.description: The parameters with which the data generator was trained (if any).

title:
Base type for data generators that can be trained.

Initial training is done using a new instance. For example, a Markov chain:
```js
var m = DataGenMarkov.make({ params: 3 }).train(['hello world', 'hey dudes']);
```

To add more samples to a trained data generator, use #train:
```js
m = m.train(['howdy folks']);
```

Restarting training is done using #retrain. For example, to reset the parameters and start new training values:
```js
var m = DataGenMarkov.make().retrain(['hola muchachos', 'hola chicos'], 3);
```

Note that parameters can be specified to retrain, but _not_ to train. Of course, a fresh instance can always be
created as well.

@var T the type of values generated (same as for {@link DataGen})
@var P the type of the parameter(s), if any
name: DataGenTrained
